question: Do the documents agree on the export capacity?

citation.quote: with a maximum export capacity of 49.9MW

citations.heading: Description of development
citations.paragraph_text: Installation of a ground-mounted solar photovoltaic array and battery energy storage system with a maximum export capacity of 49.9MW, together with associated infrastructure.

sentences.text: The power purchase agreement states 49.9 MW.

citations.heading: Schedule 1: Facility
citations.paragraph_text: Contracted Capacity: 49.9 MW (AC), measured at the Delivery Point.

sentences.text: The grid connection offer states 45 MW.

citation.quote: The Maximum Export Capacity at the Point of Connection shall be 45 MW

citations.heading: 4. Connection
citations.paragraph_text: The Maximum Export Capacity at the Point of Connection shall be 45 MW. The Connection Date shall be 1 October 2029, subject to completion of Reinforcement Works at Wickham Primary Substation.

sentences.text: These values conflict, so the check reports a conflict rather than picking one.
